command: i=0; while true; do i=$((i+1)); echo "level=info msg=\"shipped batch $i\""; sleep 3; done
containers.name: log-shipper

command: echo 'loading model /models/scorer.onnx'; sleep 2; echo 'ERROR model not found' >&2; exit 1
containers.name: scorer

command:
i=0
while true; do
  i=$((i+1))
  echo "level=info msg=\"POST /api/v1/payments 201\" latency_ms=$((i % 90 + 10))"
  [ $((i % 7)) -eq 0 ] && echo "level=warn msg=\"slow upstream: bank-gateway\" latency_ms=812"
  [ $((i % 13)) -eq 0 ] && echo "level=error msg=\"card declined\" code=51"
  sleep 2
done
containers.name: api
